_about: Crop calendar and traits for southern Ontario (Elora). Day-of-year windows are when the crop is clearly green (NDVI >= 0.4), not planting/harvest dates. All values are ASSUMED rules of thumb: check against the OMAFRA Agronomy Guide for Field Crops and, where possible, against satellite greenness (see the Lesson 7 validation).

corn.name: Grain corn
corn.note: Silking 10 Jul - 10 Aug is the heat-sensitive stage.

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.note: Harvest around late September leaves a short window for a cover crop.

winter_wheat.name: Winter wheat
winter_wheat.note: Sown in early October after soybean; harvested in July, so it escapes the corn-pollination heat window. Exposed to frost at heading (late May - early June) and to a dry June during grain fill. Wheat-specific risks (winterkill, wet-June disease) are not modelled.

red_clover.name: Red clover (underseeded in wheat)
red_clover.note: Frost-seeded into wheat in early spring; grows after wheat harvest; terminated before the next crop. A dry summer hurts its establishment.

cereal_rye.name: Cereal rye (after soybean)
cereal_rye.note: Sown right after soybean harvest; overwinters; terminated before planting.
